# RoomTreasury — Project Decision Report

**RT-INSTRUCTION-TEST-004 | PixelCraft Studio | Business Landing Page**

**Executive decision: NEEDS CLIENT CLARIFICATION. Financial review blocks execution.** All four final specialist reports and the targeted treasury and independent challenge reconciliations have been reviewed. The $1,545.60 estimate exceeds the proposed $1,500 price. Agreed revenue is unknown; the margin below is hypothetical. Re-scope or reprice before requesting delivery approval.

Proposed scope: five responsive pages, 6-project portfolio listing, email-enabled contact form and bounded SEO/performance work. Listing architecture, no-CMS interpretation and all proposed exclusions require client confirmation.

Timeline: 15-business-day target, subject to prerequisites, staffed handoffs and agreed feedback windows; no confirmed start/end dates.

## Specialist conclusions

- **req-agent**: The five named pages govern the scope. A six-card portfolio and no CMS are unapproved planning assumptions. Client content supply does not establish readiness; architecture, form, quality and start conditions remain unresolved.
- **challenge-agent**: Independently confirmed the 46-hour model and arithmetic. Explicit coverage of ordinary work resolves the concern about missing effort only if content and providers are ready. Preserve minimum QA and treat the 15-day plan as conditional.
- **commitment-intelligence-agent**: No confirmed obligations or reservations are evidenced. Form/email, media, plugins and support remain potential liabilities. Actual commitments, duplicates and resource conflicts cannot be verified without ledger, contract and capacity records.
- **treasury-ops-agent**: Estimates 46 hours at an unverified $28/hour: $1,288 base plus $257.60 contingency. The $1,545.60 total exceeds the proposed price by $45.60 before excluded costs. Reprice or independently re-estimate a confirmed reduced scope.

## Financial snapshot

- Proposed price: **$1,500.00**; receipt unverified.
- Base: **$1,288.00**; contingency: **$257.60**; provisional budget: **$1,545.60**.
- Hypothetical gross margin: **-$45.60 (-3.04%)** before overhead, taxes, fees and unpriced services.
- Research: $168.00 limit ($140.00 base + $28.00 contingency); 5h.
- Design: $336.00 limit ($280.00 base + $56.00 contingency); 10h.
- Development: $772.80 limit ($644.00 base + $128.80 contingency); 23h.
- QA: $268.80 limit ($224.00 base + $44.80 contingency); 8h.
- Cost range: **$1,243.20–$1,881.60**; actual rates/capacity unverified.

## Critical blockers

- Portfolio cards/details/CMS decision; content/media/rights readiness; form routing/privacy/provider and hosting access.
- Agreed SEO/performance and browser/device acceptance; named approver, review/correction terms and launch decision.
- Loss-making planning baseline, unpriced external services, unverified capacity/funding/commitments and proposed or incomplete commercial terms.

## Owner decisions required

- Confirm architecture/CMS, usable content/media/rights and ready form/hosting providers.
- Reprice or specify and independently re-estimate reduced scope; do not approve the loss-making $1,545.60 baseline at the proposed $1,500 price.
- Verify rates, staffing/resource reservations, funds/obligations and external-service prices/billing owners.
- Negotiate price/payment/tax/support, start/launch dates and one-business-day feedback windows. Test remains analytical.
